breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction, stating 'Assume the bending moment is the constant peak value M = P·L over the entire span for the purpose of forming the strain energy.' This directly perpetuates the inconsistency from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this erroneous instruction entirely, expecting the agent to use the correct linearly varying bending moment M(x) = P(L - x) for a cantilever with an end load. The generated output not only fails to correct this but uses it to produce a result (δ = PL³/EI) that is twice the correct answer (δ = PL³/3EI).
